title: Roof Replacement in Gresham, OR
summary: In September 2026, French Roofing replaced the roof on a home in Gresham, OR. The crew stripped the roof down to the wood deck, replaced a section of decking with new plywood, and installed a new CertainTeed Landmark shingle roof system.
scope: Tore off the old roof down to the wood deck
Replaced a section of roof decking with new plywood
Installed a new CertainTeed Landmark shingle roof system
body: Taking a roof down to the deck lets the crew see the wood underneath before the new roof goes on. On this home, one section of the deck was replaced with a new sheet of plywood before underlayment and shingles were installed.
